text: Professor, I wanted to talk to you about my work experience over the summer. Yeah sure! How was it? It was really great. I worked with a lot of talented people and I learned a lot about the business. That’s wonderful! What was your favorite part? I loved getting to work on new pieces and developing my skills. And it was really fulfilling to see my hard work pay off when we put on a great show at the end of the summer. That sounds like a really positive experience. Are you thinking about pursuing musical theater as a career? Yeah, I’m considering it. But I’m not sure if it’s the right decision for me. Well, it sounds like you have some talent and you’re passionate about it if you enjoyed your job so much. Have you talked to any professionals in the field or gone to any shows lately? No, not yet. But that’s something I want to do soon so that I can make a more informed decision. Thank you for your advice!
